messages:
maria: Hey team — PR #9782 is stuck, CI failing on macos-latest snapshots. Not sure if this is a real regression or flaky. I ran locally and one snapshot mismatched on my Mac. ryan: Which snapshot? can you paste the diff? :mag_right: maria: The failing test is `ui/header/snapshot`. Here’s the log snippet: ``` AssertionError: snapshot mismatch - expected + received
\n- Sign in\n+ Sign In\n
``` ryan: hmm small casing change — did you pull main recently? Could be a recent style tweak from #9745. CI Bot: Workflow `macos-tests` failed on job `snapshot-check (macos-latest)` for commit 7a3f2d9. Re-run available. alex: @maria if it's just casing we should update the snapshot after confirming intended UX. Otherwise rerun to check flake. sarah: I can take a look in 20m. If it's intended, we should update snapshot and add a short note in the PR about the change. james: If people want to rerun CI quickly: use `gh api repos/:owner/:repo/actions/runs/:run_id/retry` or click "Re-run jobs" in Actions. I can kick it off now. maria: thanks, james — go ahead and rerun, please. I haven't pushed any style changes in this PR. CI Bot: Re-run triggered by james for run 4521. Status: queued. ryan: while that's going, @alex can you grep main for Header text? `rg "Sign In" --heading` — just to confirm covariant change. alex: quick grep: main has `Sign In` in header.tsx since commit 7a1c9f. So looks like main changed, PR branched before that. maria: ok that explains it. So we need to update the snapshot to match main, or rebase onto main and re-run tests. sarah: recommended flow: rebase & push, then CI should pass. We prefer avoid manual snapshot updates unless intentional. james: rerun finished — CI Bot: `macos-tests` passed on re-run (all jobs green) — but note that snapshot check still flagged mismatch because branch isn't rebased. One green run doesn't mean preserved. maria: I'll rebase onto main and push a force update shortly. ryan: ping us when done for a final review. I can approve after CI passes. maria: pushed rebased branch at 1833007000, triggered CI again. CI Bot: New run 4529 started for commit 9b4c8e2. CI Bot: Run 4529 — macos-tests — all jobs passed. Snapshot check: OK. ryan: LGTM :thumbsup: I'll approve in the PR. alex: noted — no snapshot update needed. Good to merge after approvals. maria: thanks all. Merging now. Note for postmortem: add a short line about main changing header copy to avoid future surprises.
